empty.cdroms: Press an ISO or drop it here.

empty.trash: Drop a block here to remove it.

inspect.title: Settings of {{slot}}
inspect.grow: Grow to (GiB, empty keeps the size)
inspect.pinned: Keep on this node (the balancer does not move it)

check.off: The server check runs when the browser finds no errors.
check.held: The server check waits until the placement rule left by the last try is deleted.
check.upgrading: The server check works after all nodes are upgraded. The server checks when you create.
check.forbidden: You may not create VMs in this folder.
check.failed: Could not check with the server. You can still create.
check.template: The server checks a template deployment when you create it.
check.needName: Enter a name and the server checks whether the VM can be created.
check.title: Checks

help.name: Name shown in lists and screens: 1–63 lowercase letters, digits or -. It can't be changed later.

purpose.question: What will this VM run?
purpose.intro: Pick a use and the VM picture fills with fitting CPU, memory, disks and network. The disks start empty, so on the next screen you pick the OS (a template or image, or an installer ISO). You can change anything later.
purpose.noTemplates: No templates yet — turn a VM into a template and it shows here.

linux.title: Linux server
linux.text: A general server such as Ubuntu or Rocky. On the next screen you pick a template (image) or an installer ISO. First-boot setup and the guest agent are on.

web.title: Web server
web.text: A small web or API server: smaller than a Linux server (1 vCPU, 2 GiB), and a security group that opens 80/443 goes on the NIC if there is one.

database.title: Database
database.text: Plenty of memory, with separate OS and data disks.

windows.title: Windows 11 or Server
windows.text: UEFI, Secure Boot and TPM on, with devices the Windows installer knows (SATA, e1000e). A CD drive for the installer ISO boots first.

iso.title: Install from ISO
iso.text: An empty disk and a CD drive that boots first. Put the installer ISO in the drive.

template.title: From a template
template.text: Copy a template you prepared and use it right away (disks are copied too).

image.title: Image library
image.text: Download a cloud image such as Ubuntu or Debian as a template — then create from it with "From a template".

blank.title: Blank VM
blank.text: A VM with nothing attached. Add each part yourself (for experts).

purpose.noPermission: You have no folder where you may create VMs. You can look around, but Create will be refused — ask an administrator for vm.create.
purpose.templateGone: The template in the address does not exist (deleted, or not a template). Pick a use again.
purpose.windowsArm: This cluster has only Arm (virt) nodes, so it cannot create Windows VMs.

fit.fits: Fits easily in the node's memory.
fit.over: Larger than the node's free memory — it may not start.

room.overcommit: Hands out more vCPUs than the node has threads ({{pct}}%) — it can slow down when all are busy (overcommit).
room.none: No node can take this VM now (reason below).
room.noneOff: No node could start it now (creating it stopped still works).
room.other: The server did not pick a node because of another problem — fix it to see the node.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.text: If unsure, leave these as they are — the defaults work well. Each field's ⓘ explains it.
advanced.template: A template deployment cannot carry these settings (it uses the template's values). Change them after creating, in Edit VM.
advanced.cpu: CPU, memory, firmware, placement and HA

slotInfo.placement: The node the VM runs on. Automatic lets the server pick a node with room; you can also pick a node or a failure zone.
slotInfo.cloudInit: First-boot setup (cloud-init): puts the account, SSH keys and addresses in on the first start. Used with cloud images and templates.
slotInfo.protection: High availability (HA): if the node stops, the VM starts again on another node.

os.title: Pick the OS
os.text: The disks are empty. Start from a template (images downloaded in the image library included — the disk is copied from that image), or put an installer ISO in the CD drive (the CD boots first).
os.windowsText: Put the Windows installer ISO in the CD drive (it boots first). The disk and NIC driver ISO (virtio-win) can go in a second CD, if you want.
os.noTemplates: No templates — download an image in the image library and it becomes a template.
os.noIsos: No ISOs — upload one in ISO files.
os.inserted: Put ISO {{name}} in the CD drive.
